measurement_scope: Paired warm calls. Each isolated comparison replaces only its named baseline function/module; all other helpers use the frozen current package. tracemalloc allocation peaks in bytes; neither RSS nor device/native runtime totals. Robot comparisons use an independent previous package including all fitting helpers. Repair-only cases exclude their fixed initialization. Bounded asset audits are correctness checks, not performance measurements.
